description: List firewall mangle rules on a MikroTik router in evaluation order, IPv4 (family ip, the default) or IPv6 (family ipv6). Supports filtering by chain, action, and disabled state.

action.description: Filter by mangle action (e.g. mark-routing, mark-connection)

chain.description: Filter by chain name (e.g. prerouting, forward, postrouting)

family.description: Address family: ip (IPv4, /ip firewall) or ipv6 (/ipv6 firewall)

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

name: list_mangle_rules
title: List Mangle Rules
